tools.name: get_service_status
tools.description:
Provides a way to confirm the service is working.
        Returns the name of the property associated with the gift voucher catalog.

tools.name: get_voucher_catalog
tools.description:
Returns a list of gift vouchers currently offered by the connected property.
    Each gift voucher in the catalog contains a deep link url to purchase the voucher from the voucher shop.
    status: one of "active"
